body:
Fixes #23579
Clause-②: no

Lands item 3 of ruling record 6184818831 (letter D): the rule in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` that says who splits an off-lane item out of a queued card, how the split-off card is filed, and that it does not inherit the parent's domain. That file's `CEILINGS` row in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` moves by the measured delta, under ruling record 6184799323 (letter B, item 1).

## The ruling and the raise authorization

- **Ruling of record:** comment 6184818831 on #23579, letter D, the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-10-15T05:02Z). Item 3, verbatim: "One rule line in `references/execution-duties.md`: a split-off off-lane card does not inherit the parent's domain; the derived sub-issue rule (「在飞卡衍生 sub-issue 承父卡域」) keeps applying to sub-issues of the card's own lane." Items 1 and 2 of the same ruling (who splits, how the new card is filed, the parent keeps `Fixes` on its remaining items) are the content the rule carries.
- **Raise authorization:** ruling record 6184799323 on #23606, letter B, item 1, the maintainer's 「同意」, verbatim: "A ruling of record that orders text into a ratcheted file is the authorization to raise that file's ceiling by the measured lines the text needs: the raising PR quotes the ruling comment's id and the measured line delta in its body, and moves the `CEILINGS` row in the same PR by at most that delta. No second word from the maintainer is needed." Its item 5 names this card's line.
- **Measured line delta: +2.** `execution-duties.md` is 183 lines on the base (`286eb9ef3`) and 185 on this head; the `CEILINGS` row moves 183 → 185 (headroom 0). The width pin stays 0 (no table row added).

## What changed

Two rule lines, inserted directly after the derived-sub-issue pair in 〈候选与批次〉 (the lines beginning 「在飞卡衍生三分」 and 「该 sub-issue 带父卡域与优先级直接派发」). No other line in the file moved or was reworded.

```text
- 排队卡含他车道项 ⇒ 发现席自拆:新卡无 `domain:*`,首行 `carries item k of #N; #N keeps items …`。
- 分诊首触定域可改判;拆出卡 ⛔ 不承父卡域(承域只及本车道 sub-issue),父卡余项照 `Fixes`。
```

- Line 1 carries ruling items 1 and 2's filing: a queued card carrying another lane's item ⇒ the seat that finds it splits it out itself, with no triage round; the new card has no `domain:*` and its first line is the literal `carries item k of #N; #N keeps items …`. ("他车道项" reads against SKILL.md's anchor rule: `domain:*` is the domain of the package the fix lands in.)
- Line 2 carries the rest: triage stamps the domain at first touch and may regrade; the split-off card does not inherit the parent's domain, while the inheritance on the line above keeps applying to sub-issues of the card's own lane; the parent keeps `Fixes` on its remaining items.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: only the `execution-duties.md` row of `CEILINGS` (183 → 185), plus a comment block above it in the map's own convention (what the text is, the ruling that ordered it, the maintainer's word verbatim and untranslated, the authorization, "Landed count, headroom 0, same convention"). The header docblock and the refusal text are untouched; they belong to #23606.

**Why two lines, not one (measured):** this same ratchet caps every line of the file at 120 bytes. The tightest one-line spelling of the ruled content (the two lines joined into one bullet) is 235 bytes. The two lines land at 120 B and 119 B. No neighbour was re-wrapped and no rule was deleted to pay for them.
